label: DeepSeek
description: DeepSeek's in-house search engine, with its own Fetch API.

errors.cannotReach: web_search: Cannot reach the DeepSeek search endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: DeepSeek web search requires an API key — set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or configure the DeepSeek provider key. Get one at https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys
errors.unauthorized: web_search: DeepSeek API key rejected — check DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or the DeepSeek provider key.
errors.rateLimit: web_search: DeepSeek web search is rate-limited or quota-limited — wait and retry, or check your DeepSeek billing.
errors.serverError: web_search: DeepSeek web search server error ({status}) — try again later, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.parseError: web_search: DeepSeek returned unparseable response (HTTP {status}) — try again later
errors.fetchMissingKey: web_fetch: DeepSeek web fetch requires an API key — set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or configure the DeepSeek provider key.
errors.fetchUnauthorized: web_fetch: DeepSeek API key rejected — check DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or the DeepSeek provider key.
errors.fetchRateLimit: web_fetch: DeepSeek web fetch is rate-limited or quota-limited — wait and retry, or check your DeepSeek billing.
errors.fetchServerError: web_fetch: DeepSeek web fetch server error ({status}) for {url} — try again later.
errors.fetchParseError: web_fetch: DeepSeek returned unparseable response for {url}.
